newsitem.title: USA: Alltel to spend $144 million on PCS licenses.
newsitem.headline: Alltel to spend $144 million on PCS licenses.

text.p: Alltel Corp said Wednesday it will spend about $144 million on Personal Communications Services licenses in a move to expand its communications services business.
The company successfully bid for the licenses in 73 markets in 12 states in the Federal Personal Communications Services auction, it said.

When issued, the licenses will boost Alltel's potential wireless customer base to 31.4 million from 8.4 million, Alltel added. Alltel will pay about $5 per potential customer for the licenses, it said.
